sources.snippet: This is a drop-in Jinja template that fixes rendering errors, KV cache invalidation, token waste, and fatal agentic stalling in the official Qwen chat templates. It works across LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM, MLX, oMLX, and any engine that supports HuggingFace Jinja templates. You only need the single chat_template.jinja file at the root of the repository for all Qwen 3.5 and 3.6 variants.
